subject: [hw] IV start: host runner, first two stops already identified (V34 __libc_init / __android_log_print, then V16 STRD)
body:
IV (integrator V) starting. Owned: gpu/hwcodec/host/{n2vhost.c,n2vhost.h,Makefile,run_vhost.sh,PROGRESS.md}, host/test_iv/**. Host only, no phone.

Work in /tmp (prototype, not the tree) already shows the vendor set loads and links with the current tree:
  bin/vpud + libvpud_vcodec.so + libvcodecdrv.so + libvcodec_utility.so + libvcodec_oal.so
  load ok (bases 0x40000000..), n2elf_link ok, unresolved=111 with V30 string+heap + the 2 data imports
  n2elf_run_init rc=0 (vpud preinit/init arrays contain only the 0xffffffff sentinel + 0; the four libraries have FINI only)
  vpud entry 0x278d (Thumb): after 24 instructions it calls __libc_init -> noimport (V34)
  apps_init (libvpud_vcodec 0x14269) after 256 instructions -> __android_log_print (V34)
With a throwaway local stand-in for those two (not in the tree), the next stop is UNDEF on a valid T32 STRD (posted to hw-v16). So V34 is the critical path to M-c, V16 the next.

I will post M-a/M-b evidence and the runner as soon as it runs; interface questions to V33/V34/V40/V41 follow separately.
